## VINdata MCP

VINdata MCP is a remote MCP server for VIN decoding and European vehicle data. It provides automotive workflows with structured vehicle information through streamable-HTTP transport. The server exposes a decode_vin tool that returns vehicle details including make, model, year, equipment data, and derived feature flags.
